children: Shionogi's earnings are likely to be driven by HIV royalties, Jefferies analysts say in a note. Given that its joint-venture partner GSK has raised its HIV sales guidance, the U.S. bank expects the trend of strong HIV royalties to continue throughout the fiscal year. Over the medium- to long-term, Jefferies sees limited competitive threat and views the Shionogi-GSK HIV portfolio as solid. Jefferies also expects improving gross-profit margin for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis drug Radicava and lower marketing expenses for Covid-19 drug Xocova to contribute to profit. The bank maintains its buy rating and target price of 3,800 yen. Shares are up 1.6% at Y2,955.50. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
